LanguageData.DMS_DecoySite_AlreadyActive: a relay-station operation is already underway
LanguageData.DMS_DecoySite_CannotFindSite: Unable to locate a relay station: no valid site could be found on the world map.
LanguageData.DMS_DecoySite_ExpiredText: The remnant relay station's transmission window has closed. The station has relocated and its position is lost.
LanguageData.DMS_DecoySite_ClearedText: All hostiles at the remnant relay station have been neutralized. The site's equipment — including the decoy antenna — is yours to use, but expect the remnants to keep probing the area.
LanguageData.DMS_DecoySite_EntryCountdownText: You have entered a hostile remnant installation. Its monitoring protocol has flagged your presence.\n\nEnemy reinforcements will arrive in {0}. Finish your business and get out — or dig in.
